notes.title: "Boo! Hunt" First Release Version is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459864/58782c5887e7fdeb919fd579e45cf2fab38b8091.jpg[/img]

As DeadSteel Studio, we are proud to announce that our first game "Boo! Hunt" is [b]now available[/b] with it's [u]first-release version![/u]

[b]This version contains:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 Available Maps
[*] 4 Enemy Types
[*] 4 Weapon Types (Rifle, Shotgun, Double-Barrel Shotgun, SMG)
[*] 4 Available Boosts
[*] Global Leaderboard & Personal Scoreboard system
[/list]

[i]This is still an Early-Access version,[/i] more updates will come as our community grows and we receive more feedbacks for improvement!
